requirements.text: Enhance user experience to compete with fintech apps.
Provide real-time notifications for transactions including details such as amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Implement automated spending breakdowns that categorize expenses by type and allow users to set personalized monthly spending limits with alerts.
Implement biometric authentication as a primary login method.
Provide instant card controls to freeze or unfreeze cards easily.
Provide a unified view of all customer accounts on a single home screen.
Integrate in-app live chat and AI-assisted support for common queries.
Ensure compliance with PSD2, GDPR, and Central Bank regulations.
Navigate the integration challenges posed by the legacy core banking system.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months.
Ensure Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) in compliance with PSD2.
Store and process customer data within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR.
Implement strong data encryption measures for all data transmission, such as using TLS 1.3 or higher.
Ensure fairness and responsibility in lending products in compliance with Central Bank regulations.
Enhance existing APIs to support real-time data processing for instant transaction notifications.
Ensure APIs can handle complex functionalities like in-app lending applications and detailed spending categorization.
Aggregate data from different account types to provide a unified view of all customer accounts.
Provide automated monthly breakdowns of expenses categorized by type with visual representation.
Allow users to set specific monthly budgets for different categories and send notifications as limits approach or exceed.
Provide tailored suggestions based on users' spending patterns.
Implement a goal-setting feature for users to track financial goals with visual progress trackers.
Balance project constraints including legacy system limitations, budget, timeline, and compliance requirements during implementation.
